title: Taking back a plan request with weak signal makes the whole pause and renew area vanish with no word
what: A member taps 'Take back my request'. When the line is down, the take-back fails silently, the re-read fails too, and the panel hides itself: the waiting line, 'Pause my plan' and 'Renew my plan' all disappear. The member thinks the request was taken back while it still waits at the desk.
expected: A failed take-back says it could not be sent and keeps the waiting line on screen; the button shows it is busy.
how_often: when the signal drops during a take-back
fix_line: On a failed take-back or re-read, keep the last answer and show the 'Couldn't send it' words
